effects.target: the account of the Daevite civilization’s history
effects.trigger: If SCP-140 comes into contact with any fluid suitable for writing, including human blood
constraints: contact with fluid suitable for writing

evidence.locator: If SCP-140 comes into contact with any fluid suitable for writing, including human blood, the account of the Daevite civilization’s history expands.

effects.target: new artifacts and traces of the Daevite civilization
effects.trigger: Although these new segments sometimes include new descriptions of rituals or cultural traits or illustrations of previously covered material
constraints: new segments have been added to SCP-140

evidence.locator: Foundation archaeologists have discovered corresponding new artifacts and traces of the Daevite civilization in applicable locations and strata, in some cases found in dig sites that had already been thoroughly explored.

effects.target: sources of standard ink, human blood, or other fluids suitable for writing

evidence.locator: SCP-140 must never be brought closer than 15 m to any source of standard ink, human blood, or other fluids suitable for writing.

effects.trigger: Should any personnel begin displaying obsession with SCP-140 or signs of possible memetic contamination
constraints: personnel display obsession with SCP-140 or signs of possible memetic contamination

evidence.locator: Should any personnel begin displaying obsession with SCP-140 or signs of possible memetic contamination, they are to be issued a Class A Amnestic, false memories implanted as necessary, and transferred to another project.
